subject.facility_name: VILLA MARIA NURSING AND REHABILITATION COMMUNITY

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $150.58 per resident day (42.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 6.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $144,225, 4.5% of the $3,176,642 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $463,182, $21.96 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $241,192 (52.1%), allocated fringe $36,727 (7.9%), non-wage costs $185,263 (40.0%). Raw food was $157,530 ($7.47 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $989.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $139,964, $6.63 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $112,967 (80.7%), allocated fringe $17,202 (12.3%), non-wage costs $9,795 (7.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $81,131, $3.85 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $47,782 (58.9%), allocated fringe $7,276 (9.0%), non-wage costs $26,073 (32.1%).
Missing data: cost years 2017, 2018, 2022 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2022 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
